tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgom lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ ka ma la bā si ni ka ma le ma hā lakṣ+mī rā dzyam̐ me de hi de hi ba ra de swā hā/ gsang sngags 'di ni

rje btsun sgrol ma dpal chen mo'i snying po'o// rtag tu bzlas pa byas na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i mchog ster bar 'gyu 1 ra ro/ /rin la ma brtsegs par nyos pa ni/ ji lta ba bzhin du rnyed pa ste de lta bu'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i dkar zhing dri bsung dang ldan pa 'i me tog gi sbyin sreg gis bsod nams dang 'byor pa'i dpal chen po thob pa ra 'gyur zhing lha klu gnod sbyin mo dang rgyal rigs sogs mngon par 'dod pa'i bu mo 'grub par 'gyu 2 ra ba ste dbang du byed par 'gyur ro// ras bal gyi sa bon gyi tshad tsam du byas pa'i gu gul gyi ril bu ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi ste/ mngar gsum la btags pa ste sbyar ba 'i sbyin sreg 'bum mam yang na me tog padma dkar po 'i sbyin sreg 'bum gyis 'khor los sgyur ba la sogs pa'i rgyal srid sgru 3 ba par 'gyur ba ste thob par byed do// zhes 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi le'u gnyis pa las so/ /le'u gnyis pa la sngags kyi sde tshan nyi shu yod pa las 'di bcu bzhi pa'o// ༈ /swa sti/ rgyal ba ston pa la btud nas// rnam thos sras kyi btsun mor grags// lha mo dpal gyi sgrub thabs ni// shin tu rnyed par dka' phyir bshad// gtsang sbra can gyi gtor ma rgya cher bsham/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gter gyi bum pa dgu'i steng du pad zla la seng ge'i gdan/ de'i steng du shrīṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ lha mo dpal chen mo ljang gu sgeg cing bzhad pa spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas nor bus mtshan pa'i padma dang*/ g.yon skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'o// de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ gshin rje gshed kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ shrī de bī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa mo// nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin las// sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul// dpal gyi lha mo de la bstod// oṃ ka ma la bā si ni/ ka ma le/ ma hā lakṣ+mī rā dzyam̐ me/ de hi de hi ba ra de swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyi brlabs nas/ oṃ shrī de bī sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥl/ a kā ro btags pas dbul/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra'o// 'di la sgom lung 'bogs pa las gzhan pa'i rjes gnang mi dgos/ dpa' bo chig sgrub kyi rgyud la brten par mngon cing*/ jo bo'i man ngag bka' gdams pa rnams las brgyud pa'i gdams pa ngo mtshar can yin no// kun la ma grags rnyed dka' ba// thos pa nyung ba'i skyon yin te// sngags rgyud shes rnams yid dga'i gnas// snying nas yid ches gsal por bkod// lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le mtshan no// ༈ /lha mo dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyabs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo dpal gyi g.yang skyabs ni// 'gro ba rnams la phan phyir bri// gzhi ni dkar po gtsang ma'i steng*// nas kyi padma 'dab brgyad bri// de steng g.yang bshos dpe'u ris ltar// sder gtsang chag gas med par bsham// g.yas g.yon mdun du nas tshom gsum// de steng dkar gtor gsum bzhag go /de mthar gro dang gro ma dang*// mar dang thud kyi sngar chung gzugs// brung gi tshul du 'khor bar bskor// phye mar zas phud gang 'dzom dang*// g.yang phor mar khus bkang ba dang*// g.yang sgye ge lu dkar po la// rnga ma dar tshon rgyan btags pa// srung skud dkar pos kha thig bya// nang du 'bru sna g.yang rdzas bcug

/mda' dar ja chang la sogs phud// bshams pa de ni bsdus pa yin// ༈ /rgyas par g.yang bshos che ba'i mthar// rin chen 'dra ba'i bshos phran brgyad// nas kyi 'dab brgyad steng du dgod// g.yas kyi dkar gtor drung du ni// thud kyi g.yag dang mar gyi lug /'bru sna tshogs tshad ci 'dzom dgod// g.yon gyi dkar gtor drung du ni// mar gyi sbal sbrul nya gsum gzhag /'o ma zho la klu sman gdab// mdun gyi dkar gtor drung du ni// zan gyi bya rta glang gsum bzhag /shug pa rtse rgyal rting dkar la// bal tshon sna lnga btags pa bsham// de yang do dam cher byed na// skyes pa bu bdun yod pa'i mda'// bud med bu bdun yod pa yi// skra'am yang na gos dum mam// nor g.yu sna gcig gang rnyed dang*// phyug po mi rabs mang po la// dam btang rgyun mi chad pa'i nas// rgyal pos khral la bsdus pa'i nas// lug ni phyug po'i bal dum dang*// rta nor phyug po'i rta nor spu// sde pa chen po'i thab ka'i dreg /ston mo chen po'i zas sna rnams// g.yang sgye nang du blug par bya// zhing ni bzang po mang po'i sa// g.yang gzhi'i zhabs su dgod par bya// rdzas rnams ma 'dzom na yang rung*// skar ma smin drug snar ma dang*// mgo lag rgyal dang sgo nga dang*// bya rog sa ri sa ga dang*// sgrog dang bre dang bra nye la// g.yang skyabs byad dang rdzas bsags rung*// skar ma ma 'dzom na yang rung*// g.yang glu ngar mi chang bu dang*// sbang ma sha shun ram pa rnams// gyo chag gam ni sder chag nang*// bzhag la khrus chu chang skyur ram// zho lad 'o rul bran la bzhag /g.yang skyabs gzhi yi g.yas g.yon tu// bzho zo mar gyis brgyan pa dang*// sgyid thag dar ras skud pas bcing*// go khrab gos zas gang rung bsham// shug pa sur dkar mkhan dkar gyi// bsangs dud cung zad byed rgyu bzhag /khyim la gtor rgyu'i 'o dkar dang*// thun gtor rgyu yi rdo phye bsag

/dang po yi dam gtor ma bsham// rang gi yi dam lha gzhung gyer// hūm̐/ rang nyid yi dam gnas 'gyur te// dran rdzogs khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil// sku mdog ljang la dmar ba'i mdangs// g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub me 'bar mdzad// khro bo'i chas kun yongs su rdzogs// zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs dgra bgegs mnan// thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ ljang mthar// sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba las// 'od zer ljang gu phyogs bcur 'phros// 'og min gnas nas bdud rtsi 'khyil// rang 'dra dpag med spyan drangs te// bdag dang nas 'bru rnams la thim// thun rdo re dang nas 'bru re'ang*// rang 'dra'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa re// me 'bar tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur// oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces stong phrag tsam zhig bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ te kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags de phreng skor gcig gnyis kyis// 'o dkar dang ni thun sngags bzhag /oṃ a mṛ te arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabda'i bar/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// bgegs rigs 'dul ba'i gnyen por bskos// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i mthu stobs kyis// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang*// khang khyim 'di la 'khri pa yi// ltog 'gong dbul sri bse rag rnams// rang gzugs yas stags 'di la khug /bse rag rgyal po gzhon nu pa// ltog 'gong dbul sri mang pos bskor// god ka thams cad khyod las byung*// dbul 'dre dbul sri khyod las byung*// lo nyes thog nyes khyod las byung*// mi la na tsha khyod las byung*// nor la god ka khyod las byung*// mi kha bra mchu khyod las byung*// tshe la bar chad khyod las byung*// dme 'dre thams cad khyod las byung*// za kha 'thung kha khyod kyis 'phrog

/bu tsha'i bla ni khyod kyis brkus// bza' mi'i 'thab 'dre khyod kyis byas// de phyir gnod byed 'khor dang bcas// gzugs brnyan 'di la thim par gyur// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gnod byed thams cad gzugs brnyan la sib sib thim par bsgom/ de nas g.yang glud ngar mi bran/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil// ljang nag rgya gram sdigs mdzub mdzad// khro bo'i chas kun sku la rdzogs// nyon cig bse rag 'gong po'i tshogs// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di nyid la// tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas// rku 'phrog rlom pa'i lan chags bdag /thams cad 'dir 'dus glud gtor longs// gzugs mdzes 'byams klas 'jigs bral dang*// rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// rang rang yid mthun snod nang du// glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas// khyed rnams mgu zhing tshim gyur cig /bse rag rgyal po gzhon nu pa// bu chung gzugs la g.yu rna can// sba dmar gri chung sked la bcug /chibs su ri bong kha sho chibs// sreg pa bdun ni klad na lding*// khyi gu ri'u tshe shis dang sgis// chung gsum bse rag mang pos bskor// yod la mi dga' med la dga'// gang la mi dga' stong la dga'// brgyag la mi dga' ltog la dga'// phyug la mi dga' dbul la dga'// blo nyes tshong nyes btang ba'i bdag /khyod la glud dang gtor ma sbyin// yon bdag 'di la ma gnod cig /bse rag rgyal po nag po ni// mi rgan nag po chen po zhig /gos su kho shog skam po gyon// kha na rus pa snum med mur// kha nas sdug glu mug glu len// sprul pa byi la byis pa 'gyed// mchig gi steng nas phye la rku// dkar thog rlom zhing skyur thog bcom// khyod la lan chags glud gtor sbyin// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan tu song*// god 'dre mi nag phag la zhon// grod pa'i zhwa la rgyu mas brgyan// lag na bsha' gri dmar po khur// nor bdud kham pa khyi mgo sogs// god 'dre gri bo 'gong pos bskor// khyod la glud dang gtor ma sbyin// 'di ru ma gnod gzhan tu song*// gzhan yang 'gong po dam sri dang*// 'dre mo gri bo gri mo dang*// sgab 'dre ltog 'gong dbul sri rnams// ngar mi ting lo chang bu dang*// sha shun spang skam chang skyur dang*// zho lad ram pa la sogs pa'i// rang rang mthun rdzas 'di khyer la// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan tu dengs// yon bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la// ma nye ma 'khor ma gnod par// dpag tshad mang po'i pha rol du// da lta nyid du 'gro bar gyis// oṃ nṛ tri sha na tri ka tri i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun gyis bsngo/ sarba bighnān gatstsha gatstsha/ zhes sbra khyim mi mthong sar bskyal bcug go /de nas sngags pas thun bzung la/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil// rang 'dra'i khro chung ser ltar 'bebs// bskal pa'i me dpung 'tshubs shing 'bar// gang dag 'gro bar mi byed pa'i// bse rag ltog 'gong rdul du rlog /oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha sogs brjod cing sbra khyim nor slas thams cad du thun gtor/ de nas 'o dkar shug los gtor cing*/ hūm̐/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i byin rlabs las// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// phug gi lha la khrus gsol lo// phug lha pha mtshun g.yang rgan la// grib kyis phog pa dag gyur cig /sbra dang khyim la khrus gsol lo// rtsog 'dre dme rmugs dag gyur cig /mi dang nor la khrus gsol lo// bse rag god 'dre sangs gyur cig /oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ yam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ bam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ lam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shuddhe shuddhe a a a swā hā/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang rnam 'joms sogs 'don cing sbra khyim nor slas thams cad la gtor/ de nas g.yang skyabs bran la dbyangs dang bcas pas/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khang 'brog pa yin na sbra zhes bsgyur/ khyim 'di/ rin chen sna bdun gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs can// khor yug gser gyi rwa bas bskor// rin chen sna tshogs bcal du bkram// ma rmos lo tog spungs se spung*// dpag bsam ljon shing ldems se ldems// 'od zer 'ja' tshon lams se lam// rma g.yang sprin phung thibs se thibs// de dbus rin chen sna tshogs khri// padma zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan// bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs par// kham̐ las lha mi'i 'dod yon tshogs// g.yang rdzas mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs// zag med nam mkha'i mdzod gyur pa// rma g.yang lha tshogs thams cad rnams// rab tu dgyes pa'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ a kā ro sogs/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ hūm̐/ de ring gza' skar tshes grangs bzang*// g.yang rdzas sna tshogs ri ltar spungs// dar dkar mda' dar g.yab mos g.yab// rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'bod// 'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na// ri rab chen po'i byang gi ngos// gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo yi// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog na// skyed mos tshal bzang me tog 'od// khang bzang gser gyi rgyal mtshan na// bzhugs pa'i lha mo chen mo dpal// grogs mo lha mo brgyad dang bcas// yon bdag dad pas khyod 'bod na// ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsol// mtshan ni padma'i phreng ba can// mtshan nas 'bod kyis da tshur byon// dpal ldan ma dang bkra shis ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis da tshur byon// dkar mo nor gyi bdag mo ste// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= /grags pa chen mo padma'i spyan// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= /byed pa mo dang 'od chen mo// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= /rin po che ni rab sbyin ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= /zas sbyin ma dang dpal chen mo// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= khyod kyi 'khor gyi grogs mo brgyad// nor rgyun ma dang zla shel ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= /sbyin byed ma dang rab sbyin ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= /'phags ma sbas ma rab bzang ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis= /lha mo chen mo dbyangs can ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis da tshur byon// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// lha mo 'byon pa'i gnas ngan yang*// khyod la sems can don las med// byang chub sems ma khyed dgu yang*// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// snying rje'i thugs kyis myur du byon// khang khyim g.yang rdzas 'di rnams la// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ de wī ma hā shrī de wī aṣṭa sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣṭha lhan/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rig stong yum// shes rab chen mo lha mo dpal// 'khor ni nor rgyun ma la sogs// lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa la// dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon dang*// dag cing dri bral zhabs bsil dang*// sna tshogs mdzes pa'i me tog dang*// tsan dan la sogs bdug spos dang*// ma rig mun sel snang gsal dang*// ga bur sogs sbyar rmad byung dri// ro brgya dang ldan bshos gtsang dang*// sgra snyan rol mo sna tshogs 'bul// mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// dri bzang lha mi'i bcud ldan zas// sna tshogs reg bya dpag med 'bul// dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' btung dang*// zag med bdud rtsi gtor ma'i tshogs// sman 'bru dri dang snying po lnga// dar zab gos kyi bye brag 'bul// gdugs bzang gser nya padma dung*// bum pa rgyal mtshan dpal be'u 'bar// 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang*// blon po glang po rta mchog dang*// dmag dpon la sogs rin chen 'bul// yungs kar dūrwa bil ba zho// me long li khri dung dkar dang*// gi waṃ la sogs srid gsum na// mchod 'os rmad byung ji snyed 'bul// rta glang gnag lug 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma he la sogs bzhon pa'i tshogs// khang bzang dpag bsam skyed tshal 'bul// lha klu dag la che ba'i nor// rin chen baiḍūr gser g.yu dngul// mu tig bye ru shel la sogs// rin thang che ba'i nor rnams 'bul// gdugs dang bla bre dar dpyangs dang*// 'phan dar chun 'phyang rnga yab dang*// rin chen dar zab za 'og gi// gdan gos yo byad dpag med 'bul// nas 'bras gro sran til dang khre// sna tshogs 'bru yi phung po dang*// rtsi bcud mar gyi longs spyod dang*// nye bar 'tsho ba'i kha zas tshogs// dpag med rnam dag blo yis 'bul// mdor na rab 'byams zhing khams na// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// mchod 'os mchod pa'i bye brag tshogs// thams cad gcig tu bsdus te 'bul// bdag la brtse bar bzhes nas kyang*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor mchog thun gyi// dngos grub gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar phob// byang chub rgyal sar 'tsho mdzad gsol// oṃ de wī shrī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs/

zhes pa'i mchod phreng grags pa'i mtshan gyis sbyar ba dang*/ de nas gtor 'bul ni/ oṃ de wī ma hā shrī de wī aṣṭa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo dpal chen mo// sku mdog ljang gu 'od zer 'bar// phyag g.yas rin chen padma 'dzin// g.yon pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad// padma gter gyi bum pa'i steng*// zhabs gnyis btsun mo rol pa'i stabs// mdzes sdug blta bas chog mi shes// rin chen rgyan cha si li li// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// dri zhim ngad pa sangs se sang*// na bza' mang po lhubs se lhub// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// g.yang bshos rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs// phye mar shing rtsi dri bzang 'thul// g.yang phor mar khus ltems se ltem// ro bcud zas sna rdza ltar bkram// nor sna g.yang rdzas brud ltar brtsegs// ja chang 'o zho mtsho ltar bskyil// 'bru sna phye mar gangs ltar spungs// zad med kun bzang mchod sprin 'dis// mchod do g.yang gi lha mo mchod// gsol lo mchod do dgyes gyur cig /mda' dar 'di la rten chos la// khang khyim 'di la bzhugs su gsol// yon bdag 'di la dngos grub stsol// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil ba dang*// sprin dpung bzhin du gtibs pa dang*// bar snang char bzhin dbab tu gsol// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho baiḍūrya dang gser gyi ri kha dog bzang po gser du snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ dam pa'i chos dkon mchog gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

lan gsum/ g.yang gi lha mo dpal chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ g.yang gi lha mo dpal ldan ma la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo bkra shis ma la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo padma'i phreng ba can la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo nor gyi bdag mo la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo dkar mo la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo grags pa chen mo la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo padma'i spyan la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo byed pa mo la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo 'od chen mo la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo zas sbyin ma la= mchod do= byin gyis= g.yang gi lha mo rin po che rab tu sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di la tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa zas nor longs spyod g.yang gi dngos grub chen po myur du stsol cig dpa' bo gcig grub las gsungs pa'i rtsa ba'i snying po ni/ oṃ ka ma la wā se ni/ ka ma le/ ma hā lakṣ+mī rā dzyam̐ me/ ba su nā nā kha dhe sarba siddhi/ de hi de hi ba ra de swā hā/ zhes pa ci 'grub dang*/ syād ya the dan/ dzi ni ghṛ ni sarba artha sādha ni/ sha shi ni/ a lakṣa mi ni/ me nā sha ya/ siddhyantu me mant+ra pa dāḥswā hā/ oṃ bhṛ ku ṭī pa ra ma su bha ge swā hā/ zhes bdun las mi nyung bar brjod/ hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo nor rgyun ma// sku mdog ser mo gser gyi mdog /phyag g.yas 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// 'bru yi char pa si li li// g.yon pas gter gyi bum pa 'dzin// 'dzad med dngos grub chu bo'i rgyun// rin chen rgyan cha si li li// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// padma gter gyi bum pa'i steng*// sgeg bzhad gar stabs khyugs se khyug

/khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// g.yang bshos phye mar zas phud 'bul// bzang shing phye mar spos kyis mchod// mda' dar 'di la rten chos la// khang khyim 'di la bzhugs su gsol// yon bdag 'di la dngos grub stsol// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil du gsol// sprin phung bzhin du gtibs pa dang*// bar snang char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod// hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo zla shel ma// sku mdog ser mo/ sogs nas tshig rkang nyi shu 'gre'o// hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo sbyin byed ma// sku mdog ser mo= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo rab sbyin ma// sku mdog ser mo= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo 'phags ma ni// sku mdog ser mo= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo sbas ma ni// sku mdog ser mo= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo rab bzang ma// sku mdog ser mo= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo dbyangs can ma// sku mdog ser mo= tadya thā/ dzi ni gṛ ni/ sarba a ka ryā siddha ni/ si si mi/ si li si/ ni mi ni mi/ a lakṣa yā me/ nā sha ye swā hā/ oṃ bā su dha riṇyai swā hā/ oṃ tsand+ra kānt+yai swā hā/ oṃ dā dā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dā dā yai swā hā/ oṃ ārya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā yai swā hā/ oṃ guptā yai swā hā/ oṃ de byai swā hā/ oṃ sa ra swast+yai swā hā/ sarba ba su siddhi hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes tshar gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod/ de nas g.yas phyogs kyi dkar gtor bran la/ hūm̐/ steng phyogs 'dod khams lha yi yul// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas mchog nas// nor dang g.yang gi bdag po ni// nor lha lha chen tshogs kyi bdag /sku mdog dkar la glang chen dbu// phyag bzhi la phug dgra st+wa dang*// zas gzhong rin chen phreng ba 'dzin// chibs su byi ba sngon po chibs// 'dir byon dkar gtor mchod pa bzhes// thud g.yag mar gyi lug gu dang*// 'bru sna'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// yon bdag rta nor zhing khang la// bgegs kyi gnod pa khyed kyis srungs// 'khor la bka' nan ma chung zhig

/steng phyogs lha yi phywa dang g.yang*// char pa bzhin du 'bebs par mdzod// khyad par dud 'gro rkang bzhi rnams// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ba ra ka ta swā hā/ ba su sarba siddhi siddhi hūm̐ swā hā/ de nas g.yon phyogs kyi dkar gtor bran la/ hūm̐/ 'og phyogs rgya mtsho klu yi yul// bkra shis 'o ma'i rgya mtsho nas// klu g.yang dngos grub kun gyi bdag /klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni// sku mdog dkar po dung gi mdog /sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka la// rin chen 'bar ba'i cod pan can// phyag gnyis gter bum thugs kar 'dzin// sku smad gser sbrul ser po 'khyil// g.yang gi rgya mtsho me re re// 'dir gshegs g.yang rten 'di la bzhugs// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dkar gtor klu sman 'o zho'i phud// dung sbrul dung nya dung sbal 'bul// 'og phyogs klu g.yang dngos grub de// rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil bar mdzod// bu nor bde skyid dngos grub stsol// klu g.yang mi la dbab tu gsol// oṃ nā ga rā dza ma nu ṣe nā tha i daṃ ba ling ta khā hi khā hi/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sarba siddhi siddhi hūm̐ swā hā/ de nas mdun gyi dkar gtor bran la/ hūm̐/ bar phyogs lha srin gnyen gyi yul// shar phyogs gangs ri rtse rgyal nas// rma g.yang kun gyi mnga' bdag ste// rma rgyal spom ra lha yi sras// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro// dbu la dung rmog stag 'phru can// sku la ber dkar bse khrab gsol// stag dong gzig shubs sked la bskor// phyag na mdung dar nor bu 'dzin// chibs su rta dkar 'phur shes bcibs// rma rigs sum rgya drug cu dang*// rma sman 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// thugs kar yid bzhin nor bu las// dngos grub sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs// 'dir gshegs yon bdag kha 'dzin mdzod// dkar gtor zas phud sna tshogs dang*// bya rta glang gzugs mchod pa 'bul// rma dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// na bun bzhin du 'thibs par mdzod// mi 'phen rta hrag dngos grub stsol// btsan phyug dar gsum 'dzom par mdzod// oṃ ku mā ra phu tri sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta khā hi khā hi/

oṃ ku mā ra phu tri sarba siddhi siddhi hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes rab brgya tshar 'bring lo grangs sam nyer gcig gam bcu gsum/ tha ma bdun nam yang mtha' tshar gsum 'don/ 'don tshe shug dud phye mar gsur ma chad par bya'o// zhag gcig gam zhag mang na legs/ de nas g.yang bshos che ba yon bdag mos bkyag mda' dar skyes pa des bzung*/ gzhan yang dkar gtor rnams dang*/ zas sna gtor ma sogs sder du bzhag yon bdag tshang gi mi du yod kyis lag tu bzung la/ thams cad thang du 'dug bcol/ rang gis nas gtor zhing bkra shis brjod/ de nas zas phud cung zad re dang 'bru sna sogs g.yang sgye nang du blugs la tshags bya'o// mda' dkyil ka la bcings nas tshags dam du bya/ shug pa ka ba la bcings sam 'brog pa yin na slas nang du btsugs/ de min gtor ma mchod rdzas thams cad phyi mi la mi sbyin dngos grub tu bza'/ g.yang gzhi'i 'og gi sa zhing nang du blug 'brog pa yin na slas nang du gtor/ g.yang lha ye shes pa thams cad sbra khyim mi nor la thim par bsgom/ 'jig rten pa spom ra sogs rang gnas su gshegs par bsgom/ lo ka sarba gatstsha gatstsha zhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas lha mo dpal chen mo rab khyim der gnas par 'gyur la phyug cing bde skyid longs spyod phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// tha na'ang lha mo des thugs kyis dgongs te longs spyod dngos grub 'byung bar gsungs so// 'di ni mdo sde gser 'od dam pa dang*/ lha mo dpal gyi mdo dang*/ gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud dang*/ gser 'od g.yang skyabs dang*/ padma g.yang skyabs dang*/ rma spom ra'i g.yang skyabs rnams kyi don bsdus te bla ma tsā ri bas bskul ba'i ngor/ sngags 'chang rā ga a syas gser 'phyang gi lo khrum gyi zla ba'i gnam gang nyin rdzogs par bris pa la/ nyes 'gal mchis na rtsa ba gsum la bshags shing dge bas sems can thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs par gyur cig/

༈ /lha mo dpal chen mo'i g.yang chog gi zur 'debs yongs 'du'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti ka lyāe ṇaṃ bha ba tu/ mi zad dge ba'i dpal 'byor gyis// rgyal rnams mchod pa'i tshogs spel ba// dpal mo dngos grub 'byung gnas la// gus pas 'dud do mchog stsol cig /lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgrub thabs g.yang skyabs dang 'brel ba 'jig rten dbang phyug chags med zhabs kyis bka' drin tu stsal ba'i zur 'debs 'di la don rnam pa gnyis te/ 'don sgom gyi snod rung du bya ba sgom lung dang*/ ji ltar sgrub tshul dngos bshad pa'o// dang po sgom bzlas kyi lung 'bogs pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan la lung 'bogs pa'i sngon tu rang nyid kyis nyams len tshar gcig bya ste/ stegs gtsang mar maṇḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mdun tu gtsang sbra can gyi gtor zlum/ mchod pa rnam bdun bcas bsham/ rang nyid phyag rdor zhi ba gang rung gi bdag bskyed dgos pas/ thog mar/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po nam mkha'i mdangs can/ zhi zhing 'dzum la 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas thugs kar 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ na bza' mchog dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu bzhad cing rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no// de'i drung du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngo sang khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing dgra st+wa 'dzin pa'o// rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/

badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba gsal bar gyur/ na mo badzra pā ṇa yi/ ma hā badzra pra tiṣṭhi tā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sha rī ra antarga tā ya/ badzra sha rī ri/ me ku ru badzra a dhiṣṭhā na swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ mchod pa rnams/ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas shabda'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā bart+ta ya ā bart+ta ya hūm̐/ rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin brlab/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gter gyi bum pa dgu'i steng du pad zla la seng ge'i gdan/ de'i steng du shrīṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las lha mo dpal chen mo ljang gu sgeg cing bzhad la spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas nor bus mtshan pa'i padma 'dzin cing g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de'i shar du zla shel ma/ lhor sbyin ma/ nub tu sbyin bzang ma/ byang du 'phags ma/ shar lhor rab bzang ma/ lho nub tu rab sbas ma/ nub byang du nor rgyun ma/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma ste thams cad gser btso ma'i mdangs can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams shing padma dang gter gyi bum pa la btsun mo rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin mo rnams dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'o// spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

thugs kar hūm̐ dang shrīṃ/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lcang lo can gyi skyed mos tshal nas lha mo dpal chen mo 'khor gnod sbyin ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis lha la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje gshed pos dbur brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ma hā de wī shrī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa mo// nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin las// sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul// dpal gyi lha mo de la bstod// 'gro la dmigs med thugs rje yis// thabs mkhas rang bzhin skur sprul pa// gnod sbyin lha mo'i tshogs rnams la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i shrīṃ yig ljang gu'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas bskor mi g.yo ba gsal bar bltas la/ oṃ ka ma la bā si ni/ ka ma le/ ma hā lakṣ+mī rā dzyam̐ me/ ba su nā nā kha dhe sarba siddhi/ de hi de hi ba ra de swā hā/ 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad kyi thugs kar so so'i sa bon mthar sngags phreng gsal btab nas/ oṃ bā su dha ri ṇyai swā hā/ oṃ tsand+ra kānt+yai swā hā/ oṃ dā dā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dā dā yai swā hā/ oṃ ārya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā yai swā hā/ oṃ guptā yai swā hā/ oṃ de byai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa st+yai swā hā/ zhes bzla// mthar gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ oṃ shrī de wī sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ.a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/

mchod cing bstod pa'i mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs dang*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad dbul ba'i 'jigs pa las grol zhing mdzad pa med pa'i dpal 'byor chen po la longs spyod pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba ni/ a mṛ ta bzla bzhin pas sgo drung du chab btang*/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trām̐ gis me tog bkye/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gnas skabs dbul ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing*/ mthar thug tshogs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor yongs su rdzogs pa 'gro ba'i bla ma'i go 'phang la dgod par bya ba'i slad du lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgom lung gsan par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de'ang 'das pa'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho baiḍūrya dang gser gyi ri mdog mdzes gser 'od dpal zhes bya ba la thugs bskyed cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal stug po sogs sangs rgyas du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ bder gshegs 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyal mtshan gser bzang po las nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin zhus nas dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi sbyin bdag chen mor gyur la/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'jig rten gyi khams dpal rin po ches brgyan pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal nor bu rin po che las byung ba zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba/ ngo bo sa la gnas pa'i sems ma'i tshul gyis rgyal ba thams cad mchod pa dang sems can gyi dbul ba sel ba'i thugs bskyed phrin las la mnga' mdzod cing*/ rnam pa gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos sras kyi yum gyi tshul du snang ba/ mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis dbul ba dang nyes sdig thams cad med par byed pa/ sdig pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ bsod nams thams cad sdud par byed pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad med par byed pa/

dpal dang bde ba dang skal pa bzang po thams cad sdud par byed pa 'di ni/ rgyud sde rnams kyi rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud la rigs drug tu yod pa'i snga ma 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum gyi nang tshan padma'i rigs kyi bka' nyan tu gtogs pa dpal lha mo lung bstan pa'i mdo sogs las gsal bar gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang gshegs rigs kyi yum gser 'od dam pa dang*/ nor can gyi rigs gar mkhan mchog gi brtags pa rnams las kyang 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs snying po bcas bstan par mdzad la/ skabs su babs pa'i sgom lung 'di ni/ gshegs rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub las legs par gsungs pa/ de la brten te jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i man ngag bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis phyag bzhes su mdzad pas byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang yid ches kyi nges pa ster bar byed pa ste/ de lta bu'i sgom lung zab mo gsan pa'i slad du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ thal mo me tog dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'di dag dpon slob lhan cig pas gnang bar zhu/ zhes skyabs sems tshad med bzhi lan gsum/ de nas spyan dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzad par 'tshal/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar nyi ma la gnas pa'i sogs gong ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa dor/ khyed rang gsang ba'i bdag po zhes bsgyur/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon kyang gsang bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags phreng*/ de las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba la 'khod pa'i mos pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ na mo badzra sogs gsum/

rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus pa ma lus pa 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig ces me tog 'thor/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs sngon tu 'gro ba'i mdun bskyed gsal 'debs pa la spyan dmigs 'di ltar du mdzad 'tshal/ zhes brda sbyar nas/ mchod pa kha gsos te/ gong gsal mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ bstod pa'i bar slob dpon gyis brjod la brda sprad/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su shrīṃ yig ljang gu sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso mo'i sngags lan gsum/ 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad po rang rang gi thugs ka'i zla steng sa bon las rang rang gi sngags rnams byung*/ zhal nas zhal du brgyud/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs srog la thim pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'khor sngags rnams lan gsum bzlar gzhug mthar me tog 'thor bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de nas mdun bskyed la gtor ma 'bul ba'ang nged kyis brda sprad pa'i dmigs rim la 'jug par zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ 'dod don gsol gdab kyi bar gong bzhin bya/ de ltar jo bo rje lha gcig gi man ngag lha mo chen mo dpal gtso bor gyur pa'i gnod sbyin mo dgu'i sgom lung bka' gtad sbyin grub pa yin pas 'di dag lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ dge bsngo byas pas grub bo// rjes mchod pa kha gso/ byin rlabs mchod bstod gong gsal/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ yig brgya brjod/ rten yod na mdun bskyed rnams de la bstim zhing med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/

bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu zhing skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs la gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo'o// //gnyis pa lag len dngos bshad pa la gnyis/ gzhung mthun gyi bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul mdor bstan/ g.yang skyabs dkyus ma'i lag len rgyas par smos pa'o// dang po ni/ lha mo chen mo 'di nyid ched du bsnyen par 'dod na/ bca' gzhi/ sgom don/ sngags rgya/ spyod lam sogs bya ba spyi rgyud gyis khog dbub/ 'di nyid kyi mdo rgyud rtog pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bye brag tu bsdebs te nyams su len dgos pa yin kyang*/ yul dus dbang gis ji bzhin 'grub dka' bsam smos la/ rjes mthun tsam lag tu len par spro na/ gnas khang rgyan gyis brgyan par stegs bu gtsang ma la rin po che'i maṇḍal la dri dang ba byung gis byug pa la/ tsan dan dkar po las byas pa'i dpal mo'i sku gzugs nang du ring bsrel dang ldan pa bzhag mdo sde gser 'od dam pa'i glegs bam yang bzhugs su gsol/ ma 'byor na bris sku'am tsaka li dgram pa'i mdun tu 'bul gtor dkar gsum las byas pa/ 'o chab kyi mchod yon/ me tog ser po/ tsan dan la sogs pa'i bdug spos/ sbrang rtsi bu ram dang sbyar ba'i zhal zas sogs mchod pa dag cing gtsang ba bsham/ bgegs la gtor ma byin te bskrad/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i chus mgo lus dag par bkrus shing gnas mal yo byad rnams la 'thor/ sngags bzlas pa'i gu gul dkar pos bdug gos gtsang ma gyon/ nyen re bzhin khrus bya/ ma grub na sngags kyi chus nangs mo dang zas zos pa bshang gci 'dor ba'i rjes thog sogs la kha bshal zhing nye reg bya/ sha chang sgog btsong 'bags bcog slad zas/ bag med dang mi dge'i spyod pa/ sngags bzla ba'i skabs su bza' btung bshang gci gtam lab gnyid dang glal sgrid sogs ci nus kyis spangs te/ nyams len dngos gong smos bdag mdun gyi rim pa rjes chog bcas thun bzhi'am gsum du byed/

sngags bzla ba'i tshe bdag bskyed 'od zer spro bsdu spyi mthun gyis rung zhing thun 'gor bzlas pa brgya brgyad tsam res chog dngos gzhi mdun bskyed gtso mo'i rig sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ gtso mo'i yi ge'i gzugs dang dril bu'i skad lta bu'i sngags kyi sgra gdangs la sems rtse gcig tu gtod cing*/ skabs su bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed bskul/ de'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna tshogs byung ba'i rtse mo las lha mo chen mo'i sku nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab pa byung*/ de dag gi phyag mthil nas mchod pa'i sprin chen po'i sprul te rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod pa'i dge ba las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi sprin chen po 'khrigs pa las/ bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs pas rgyu ser sna dang 'dod chags kyi dri ma bkrus/ 'bras bu yi dwags kyi 'gro ba kun tshims nas sangs rgyas kyi bde ba la bkod/ yang*/ nor bu rin po che la sogs pa 'dod rgu'i char rgyun tshad med pa babs pas bdag gzhan 'gro ba mtha' dag skye ba kun tu dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter chen po la dbang thob/ 'od zer slar log ste thugs kar thim par mos/ lha mo brgyad la'ang des rigs 'gre zhing grangs gtso mo'i bcu char bzla/ 'di ni blo zo ma yin te/ spyod rgyud kyi gzugs kyi lha'i spro bsdu dang*/ gser 'od dam pa las zur gyis bstan pa'i don gcig tu 'dus pa 'phags bod kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po dag gis legs par bshad pa'i dgongs pa'o// de lta bu'i bsnyen pa legs par grub nas/ sgrub pa'i tshul du mdun bskyed la spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs kyi skabs su tshigs bcad kyis mtshon spros pa rgyas par bya zhing*/ bzlas pa'i thog mar mdo sde gser 'od dam pa nas 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan spyi dang*/

khyad par bde gshegs rin chen me tog dang*/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po la phyag bya zhing mchod pa phul/ gzungs sngags dang bden tshig lan bdun la sogs pa brjod nas/ sngar smos pa'i snying po rnams dang*/ syād ya thed na dang*/ tadya thā zhes pa rigs gnyis kyang ci nus su bzla/ thun mthar gtor 'bul mchod bstod rgyas par bya zhing dpal lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis la phyag mchod 'dod don gsol ba btab nas mdun bskyed sku gzugs la brtan bzhugs gsol/ bsnyen sgrub gnyis ka'i thun mtshams su phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa gtso bor gyur ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog ci 'grub bya/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa'i mdo dang*/ dpal lha mo'i mdo/ gser 'od dam pa sogs ci nus su bgrag bza' btung gi bya ba sogs grub nas nye reg byas te thun la 'jug sgrub pa grub pa'i tshe las la sbyor ba'i don tu khrus dang gos gtsang bgo zhing lus spos kyis bdug pa sogs byas nas/ brtan bzhugs byas pa'i lha mo'i sku de 'bru sna dang rin po che lnga'i phur ma der ser po rnams kyis dril ba snyim pa kha sbyor du bcug ste ji tsam ci nus pa'i bzlas brjod 'bru nor la don gnyer che chung dang bstun pa'i zhag grangs su byas la mthar mdzod khang gi dbus su 'bru'i phung po'i steng du bzhag la/ de phyin chad dus bzang po byung ngo cog la sbrang rtsi bu ram 'o ma'i mchod yon rnams dang zas nor gyi phud thams cad kyis mchod cing 'bru nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i gsol ba gdab/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag la sogs pa sngon tu song nas/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha mo 'khor bcas gsal bar bsgom pa'i mdun tu 'bras bu can gyi shing la me thab las thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid can du byas shing dmigs/ bsreg rdzas 'bras bu can gyi yams shing*/ mar khu ser po/ til dkar po ci mang 'du bya/ bdag nyid gsang bdag tu gsal ba la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang mdor bsdus blang*/

me thab tu me lha spyan drangs/ a mṛ tas bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas byin brlabs la 'bul/ slar bden pa'i stobs brjod la dkyil 'khor pa me thab tu spyan drangs te lha so so'i sngags la spel tshig sbyar bas bsreg rdzas rnams lan bdun la sogs pa phul nas/ tadya thā'i sngags kho nas til dkar po ci nus su phul ba la grangs bzung*/ mthar mar khu lan gsum phul nas lha rnams dkyil 'khor du gshegs/ me lha gsal btab nas bsreg rdzas/ mchod pa/ slar mar khu lan gsum phul la gshegs/ thab kyi me rang zhir song ba'i thal ba 'bru la sogs pa'i mdzod du btab na 'bru nor zad mi shes par 'phel bar 'gyur ro// //gnyis pa g.yang skyabs dkyus ma tsam gyi phyag len bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum/ bca' gzhi dang*/ gzhung gi lag len dngos/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams so// dang po la gnyis/ 'byor pa dang ldan pas bca' gzhi rgyas par spro na rten rdzas kyi gtso bo gong du smos pa'i sku dang glegs bam dag yod dgos la/ de ltar mi 'joms pa'am spyi mthun stabs bde tsam du gzhung 'di las dngos su gsungs pa ltar/ skyes pa bu bdun yod pa'i mda' ma nyams pa la/ dar ras gtsang ma spyi dang ma 'dres pa la lha mo gtso 'khor srid gsum g.yang bdag dang ces pa'i sku dang sngags byang bris pa dang dngul dkar me long*/ bud med bu bdun yod pa'i nor g.yu/ gzhan yang dar sna/ stag gzig ras ma/ khrab byang sogs btags pa rten rdzas kyi gtso bor yin pas gang 'dzom bya dgos la/ de'ang ma 'dzom na mda' dar dkyus ma me long ldan pa med ka med yin/ chags med rin po che nyid thugs bskyed che drag pas de'ang mi 'dzom pa'i dbul po la dgongs nas mda' dar med na de'i tshab tu shug pa bal tshon gyis brgyan pa bzhag par gsungs pa'i gnad ma go ba/ da lta g.yang shug ces shug thel zhig ma bzhag ka med byed pa ni blun po'i bya ba yin pas cis kyang mda' dar ma 'dzom nas bcad tsam ma gtogs/

sgrub rten tu shug pa bzhag mi rung ste skam nas grug pa sogs kyis rten 'brel mi legs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang gzhung las gsungs pa'i g.yang rdzas rnams tshogs par byas la/ nyi ma byang bgrod/ ra ba bzhi sogs yar ngo'i tshes g.yang gza' g.yang skar 'dzom zhing dbul nyi nyi nag sogs med pa'i dus bzang po zhig la thog ma'i dbu 'dzug pa dang*/ rjes kyi g.yang gtad khel bar byas te/ gnas khang gtsang ma rgyan gyis spras pa'i phug logs sogs gang bder rang gi yi dam gyi gzhung gang la byed pa'i gtor mchod tshogs kyi yo byad sogs bsham/ stegs bu gtsang mar dar ras ser po'am dkar pos g.yogs pa'i khar 'bras sam gro nas kyis padma 'dab brgyad bris pa la 'bru gtsang gi phye sman dang rin po che mngar gsum bsres pa las g.yang bshos nor bu'i dbyibs can gtso 'khor dgu rgyan spros gzab pa byas te snod gtsang gas chag med pa'i nang du bkod la bzhag sku dang glegs bam yod na de nyid dbus su bkod pa'i mdun du gtor ma 'di 'jog dgos/ gang ltar g.yas g.yon mdun gsum du 'bru'i tshom bu'i khar lha klu gnyan gsum dkar gtor rgyan ldan gzhung gsal/ rgyab ngos su gong smos sgrub rten mda' dar g.yo 'gul med pa'i stegs la gzug mdun tu mchod pa rnam bdun gong smos ltar phreng tshar dang*/ gzhan yang snod gtsang ma rnams su lnga phrag lnga/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/ mar thud 'o zho/ phye mar/ ja chang*/ shing tog khur ba sogs bza' bca' btung ba gtsang zhing dag pa'i rigs ji tsam 'tshogs pa bsham/ dar dkar ram shog bu la bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ rgya nag lugs kyi nor bu cha bdun tu grags pa rnams bris pa'i rgyab tu rten 'brel snying po'i gsham la/ bdag gam/ sbyin bdag 'di zhes bya ba la tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa'i mi nor zas gsum g.yang gi dngos grub chen po char bzhin tu phob cig

puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes bris pa ci bder bkod pa'am gong gi mda' la btags kyang rung*/ go khrab rgyan gos sogs bkra shis pa'i yo byad rnams dang*/ nor lha spyi'i rten tu grags pa rnga ma dkar po dar snas brgyan pas mtshon g.yang 'gugs pa'i rten gzhung gsal gang 'tshogs bya/ gyo tshal la sogs pa'i snod bor chog zhig gi nang du g.yang glud bsdus pa ngar mi ting lo changs bu can gyis 'thus par mdzad kyang*/ spro na 'don cha dang mthun pa'i bse rag gi gzugs chung gsum gyi 'khor rnams spar du btab pa'i sngon phyogs su/ mi dang rta nor ra lug gi glud gzugs mar me bshos bu changs bu rnams dang*/ tshwa sgog ram gsum sogs mi kha'i yas rdzas/ zo she rkyal she stan rul god rus thag chad sogs 'gong po'i bkar yas ci rigs pa bsags/ thun rdo'i phye ma yungs kar ram nas dang bsres pa/ snod gtsang mar 'o chab 'thor byed dang bcas pa/ g.yab dar mda' dar dkar po/ shug pa bal bu sogs bzang shing gi spos sbyor/ mchod pa rnams kha gso ba'i chas sogs 'du bya/ sgrub pa'i dbu btsugs nas g.yang sgo bsdams zin pa'i zhag gsum mam bdun gyi bar du yo byad bza' btung rigs spyi dang*/ khyad par dkar mtshan can dang bkra shis pa'i rdzas phyir mi btang ba'i 'dzem bya dgos kyang gnas chen lta bu de ltar 'grub dka' ba'i rigs la yul lugs dang bstun zhing*/ g.yang rten du bzhag pa'i yo byad che phra thams cad nam yang phyir mi 'khyer ba dang*/ mchod rdzas kyi ras ma sbyin bdag gam sgo nor rtsis can lta bur sbyin pa las/ bya khyi tsam la'ang sbyin par mi rung ngo*// sngar cho ga dang 'brel ba'i rten btsugs pa yod na/ zur gsal ltar sgo dbye ba'i cho ga byas te g.yang rten rnams spos dud sogs bkur bsti dang bcas te spyan drangs la gzhi steng du bkod cing*/ rgyan spros kyis mtshon te kha gso dogs pa rnams gso zhing*/

mchod pa'i bye brag la sogs pa gsar du bsham par bya'o// gnyis pa 'byor pas dman pa'am nyin chog lta bur bca' gzhi bsdus pa'i tshul ni gzhung gi dbur gsungs pa ltar ro/ ༈ /gnyis pa lag len dngos gzhi ni/ thog mar bdag bskyed yi dam gang byed kyi gzhung bzlas pa'i bar du btang dgos pas/ zhag grangs byed tshe dkon mchog spyi 'dus la mtshon na dbu nas brtsam/ seng gdong ma'i bzlas pa'i bar du btang*/ de mtshams nor can dang rgyas pa'i rigs la nges par dgos pa gong smos phyag rdor bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'ang bya/ nyin chog gam tshar re zung la phyag rdor bskyed bzlas 'di kho nas chog gi spros pa gzhan mi dgos/ de nas gzhung gsal/ hūm̐/ rang nyid yi dam sogs la 'jug ste/ de'i tshe rang nyid las kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags phreng g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ mthu stobs byin rlabs thams cad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan gyi rnam par char bab pa ltar byon nas bdag dang thun rdzas la thim pas bdag nyid mthu stobs gzi brjid rab tu rgyas shing*/ thun rdzas rnams khro chung me 'bar zhing tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur par mos la/ a mṛ te stong phrag tsam dang*/ kuṇḍa li brgya tsam bzlas la phus btab pas/ thun rdzas kyi khro bo rnams 'od du zhu ste hūm̐ yig ljang sngon me'i tshwa tshwa thul 'phro ba 'ba' zhig tu gyur par mos la/ mchod bstod bya/ 'o chab kyi steng du sgrub pa po gtsang sbra la gnas pa yin na skad cig dran rdzogs su rdo rje rnam 'joms ljang sngon dang*/ sha chang sogs la 'bags na dkar por gsal ba'i thugs srog dang sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab 'o chab dag byed kyi khrus chu nus pa dang ldan par mos la/

rnam 'joms tshar gcig dang nye snying gang 'grub/ sham bu khrus bdun rig pa sbyar ba'am bdun tsam phan yon bcas brjod la lha mi dmigs par bzhag rang nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus dbul phongs byed pa'i bse rag dang god 'dre sogs bgegs rigs thams cad mdun tu bkug ste gus pas 'khod/ glud gtor de dag rnams kyi yid la gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por bsams la gzhung tshig gyer/ do gal byed na glud rdzas kyis kha gso zhing lan bdun la sogs pa tshar grangs bsag na maḥsarba sogs la chu gtsang sbra dgos/ mthar de dag tshims nas phyi mig mi lta bar mtha'i rgya mtsho pha rol du song bar bsams la/ glud gtor khang khyim mi mthong ba'i sar skyel la phyi mig mi lta bar log bcug glud mi len cing bden tshig la mi nyan pa'i 'byung po gnod pa'i sems 'chang ba mtha' dag rang gi sku las spros pa'i khro chung me phung thun rdzas hūm̐ yig mtshon chen 'bar ba'i char gyis bskrad cing rdul phran tsam du brlags par byas par mos la/ mtshams bcad brjod cing 'khyil pa'i sngags dang*/ sumbha drag tu bzla bzhin pas khyim phyi nang thams cad du rdo thun gtor/ slar khro chung thams cad tshur 'dus pa las byung ba'i rdo rje mtshon cha me ri'i gur khang cis kyang mi shigs pa'i nang du bsrung bya'i gnas khang nor phyug zhing dang bcas pa tshud par bsgom/ de nas khrus tshig dang rnam 'joms kyi sngags sham bu can/ kuṇḍa li rnams brjod bzhin pas khrus chab phyogs thams cad du 'thor bas/ 'go ba'i lha lnga/ skyob pa'i lha dgu/ dgra bla yul lha gnyan po sogs 'go ba'i lha srung rnams la mi gtsang ba'i dri ma phog pa rnams dang*/ bdag dang yon gyi bdag po'i sdig sgrib rme rmug nal gsum gyi dri ma yul zhing nor rdzas la 'gong po bse rag gi kha rlangs phog pa sogs mdor na grib dang mi gtsang ba mtha' dag shel dkar gyi bum pa ltar bkrus nas gtsang zhing dag par mos/

'dir spro na gnas mdo bde chen snying pos mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdun bskyed bton la/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gser btso ma lta bu bdag dang sbyin bdag la phog pas/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang*/ bye brag ser sna'i nyes pas dbul zhing phongs par 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci yod pa thams cad sang gi dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ mthar de bzhin gshegs pa nyid mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis yul phyogs gnas khang dang bcas pa bde ba can gyi zhing khams lta bu bkod pa'i khyad par mtha' yas pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs par mos/ de'i dbus su rin po che ri gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs bcas pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du gter bum dang padma zla ba'i gdan rer/ bar mtshams rnams su mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtha' skor du khrus kyi rdzing bu/ dpag bsam ljon shing*/ rin po che'i ri bo/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba mo/ nor bu'i 'gram stegs la sogs pas bskor zhing*/ phyogs mtshams kun tu 'ja' 'od dang rin po che'i sprin khrigs par bsgoms la/ swa bhā wa nas/ rang bzhin gyur bar brjod/ 'dir spro na bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod pa skabs su babs pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi bden pa'i stobs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi pho brang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa lha so so'i gdan dang bcas pa/ phyi nang kun tu yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ aṅga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa manta swā hā/ lan brgyad brjod/ de nas sarba bid pū ra sogs sbyar/ 'di brjod nas a kā ro dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod sngags gnyis mi dgos/ de nas spos kyi dud pas btang*/ mda' dar g.yab la/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lcang lo can nas lha mo dpal chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul nas sngon gyi thugs dam dran te dgyes pas dgongs te skad cig gis byon par bsams la/ spyan 'dren dbyangs rol bcas brjod/ lha mo dgu po gnod sbyin bye ba/ rgyal chen bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas te byon nas gzhal yas khang gi so so'i gdan la bzhugs shing rgyal po bzhi yang sgo bzhi la bzhugs par mos/ 'di rigs kyi bka' nyan yin par ma zad dgos pa'i 'ga' re yod pas bsgom don nges par bya dgos/ de nas rang gi thugs la sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod par mos la mchod phreng sbyar/ gzhung du gtor ma byin rlabs zur gsal ma gsungs pas/ tshar grangs bsags tshe gong du gzhal yas sogs bskyed pa'i zhar byung dmigs pas khyab par byas kyang 'thus shing*/ tshar snga ma rnams su 'di ltar sbyar te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas mnyes par mos la/ gzhung gsal sngags kyis 'bul zhing gtso mo la bstod cing phrin las bcol/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brjod pa'i tshe mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/

chos la de nyid yid la bya zhing*/ dpal chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis kyi skabs gtso mo la dmigs te/ dad mos rtse gcig pas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag bya zhing*/ mchod pa phul ba sogs mos te/ de'i tshe de dag gi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis bdag gzhan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi mthu stobs rab tu rgyas par mos/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe dmigs pa'i gnad gong du smos pa de la gtsor bya zhing*/ gzhan yang sku spros pa de dag tshur 'dus pa'i tshe bdag dang sbyin bdag la thim pas sgrib pa bsal nas byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ sku'i 'od zer las skyes pa'i nor bu'i sprin 'thug po las zas nor longs spyod kyi char chen po babs pas gnas khang bang mdzod dang bcas pa mer gyis khengs par bsams pa dang*/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lha mo gtso 'khor bskul/ de dag gis sngon gyi dam bca' rjes su dran/ thugs srog las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyi snod thams cad sbyangs bde ba can gyi zhing khams lta bur gyur/ nang bcud kyi 'gro ba spyi dang khyad par bdag dang sbyin bdag gi ser sna rku 'phrog gi nyes pas mtshon pa'i sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs/ snod bcud mtha' dag gi dpal 'byor yon tan rab tu spel/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pas 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan byin rlabs/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor/ dbang thang snyan grags/ stobs rtsal gzi brjid/ 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud/ lha klu mi'i phywa g.yang*/ mdor na brtan g.yo'i chos bcu bzhi'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te bdag mdun sbyin bdag rnams la sib sib thim par mos la/ rtsa bsnyen ci 'grub/ las sngags brgya'am nyer gcig bzla/ lha mo brgyad po brtan cing thugs dam bskul te nor rgyun ma'i thugs kar zla gdan la mtshan sngags thog ma bam̐ gser mdog bkod pas mtshon so so'i thugs srog sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas 'od zer spro bsdu gong smos lta bus nyer gcig yan ci 'grub bzla'o// de nas bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer steng phyogs su 'phros pas/

sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang gi bar khyams g.yas ngos su bzhugs par mos la/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul gyi dmigs pa gong smos kyis rigs 'gre/ lha chen po'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du gam̐ las sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khod/ bdag mdun gyi 'od kyis bskul bas/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gsum gyi dpal 'byor spyi dang*/ bye brag steng phyogs lha'i phywa g.yang thams cad 'od dang thig le dkar la 'tsher ba'i rnam par bsdus te bsgrub bya mi nor zhing khang dang bcas pa la thim pas bkrag mdangs snum bag gzi brjid dang ldan/ gnas khang thams cad longs spyod chen pos mer gyis gang*/ khyad par sprul pa du mas bgegs thams cad gzir zhing gnad la bkar bar mos la sngags ci 'grub bzla/ des gzhan gnyis la rigs 'gres te/ 'od zer phyogs su 'phros pas klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ g.yon phyogs kyi bar khyams 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil pa la bzhugs pa dang*/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i skabs/ thugs kar zla steng phuḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bye brag 'og phyogs klu'i phywa g.yang thams cad 'od dang thig le sngo la dwangs pa'i rnam par bsdus/ khyad par thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis klu chen po rnams bskul bas 'dzad pa med pa'i rin po che'i phung po phyur bur spungs bar bsams la sngags bzla/ de bzhin du/ 'od zer shar phyogs su 'phros pas rma rgyal spom ra gnyen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi khyams la bzhugs/ thugs kar zla steng shaḥyig dkar ser sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bye brag par phyogs mi dang gnyan gyi phywa g.yang thams cad 'od dang thig le ser la brjid pa'i rnam par bsdus/ khyad par thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rma g.yang dngos grub mtha' dag 'ub kyis bsdus nas gnas khang bang mdzod ra ba phyug lhas yul zhing dang bcas pa la thim pas/

rgud pa med pa'i phywa g.yang gi byin chags par mos la sngags bzla'o// de ltar tshar gcig song mtshams su spro na zur gsal g.yang bsangs nyid tshar gcig sbyar bar bya ste de'ang dpal chen mo lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas de dag la me tog dang bdug pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal la yang tsan dan bdug pa phul te sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'di dag dang*/ lha mo chen mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bklags na des dpal thams cad 'thob par 'gyur zhing bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad 'thob par 'gyur/ lha thams cad kyang bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sbed par byed par 'gyur la de'i don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang ldan pas so/ de nas nyin gcig la tshar grangs ci tsam byed kyang*/ gnas khang bskyed pa nas spom ra yan bsags shing*/ gtso bo bsngags dmigs nyid bung bskyed pa gal che/ dgong mor spro na logs su gsal ba'i gtor 'bul rgyas pa nyid 'dir sbyar/ de nas lhan thabs mjug chog gi mchod bstod thugs dam bskul ba g.yang 'gugs bcas bya zhing*/ de'i tshe ji ltar smos pa'i 'khor 'das kyi bcud dang dwangs ma phywa g.yang dpal 'byor thams cad bdag mdun 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rdul lta bus rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa ltar 'ub kyis bsdus nas bsgrub bya dang*/ khyad par mdun gyi g.yang rten rnams la sib sib thim par mos/ mthar g.yang rten de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje mtshon cha me phung gi gur du tshud pas bse rag 'gong po sris rkun sogs kyis glags lta ba'i gnas med par bsgoms la dmigs med spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ bkra shis brjod/ de nas chos skyong gtor 'bul/ yi dam tshogs skong sogs mthar dbyung zhing*/ g.yang skyabs cho ga gzhan 'don srol yod na'ang gong gi bkra shis grub pa'i rjes su sbyar na legs so// nyin phyi ma rnams su g.yang glud bkar yas bgegs bskrad khrus gsol rnams kyang spros pa la dga' na bya/

mi spro na nyin dang po de kas 'thus/ gzhan thams cad sngar bshad pa kho na ltar bskyar bar bya'o// ༈ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ g.yang sgrub zhag grangs ji tsam byed pa grub nas/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i snga dro'i char nyin bstar chags su bya ba'i rim pa las/ thugs dam bskul ba yan grub pa dang*/ stan dkar po 'bru dkar gyi g.yung drung bris pa la g.yang gtad gang la bya ba'i sbyin bdag rnams 'khod du bcug slob dpon gyis mda' dar g.yab ste g.yang 'gugs gyer ba'i tshe/ phywa g.yang rnams sbyin bdag g.yang rten gnyis ka la bkug cing bstim/ sba bstim/ nongs bshags/ ye shes pa brtan bzhugs/ 'jig rten pa lha klu gnyan gsum rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol skabs babs bya/ dpal chen lha mo 'khor gyi grogs mo brgyad dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ste rten rnams la thim pas/ g.yang rten rnams ngo bo lha mo 'khor bcas dang gnyis su med pa la/ rnam pa 'khor 'das kyi phywa g.yang dwangs bcud thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bur gyur par mos la/ mda' dar skyes pa/ g.yang bshos yon bdag mo/ gzhan rnams kyang gang 'os su gtan la g.yang gtad gyer/ lhan thabs kyi gsham du gsal ba'i bkra shis rgyas par brjod la me tog 'thor/ dkar gsum dang phye mar gyis mchod yon gnyis ka'i zhal bsro/ g.yang rten rnams sbyin bdag gis gus pa dang bcas pas bzhugs sgrom du mgo mjug go rim ma log par bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ 'byor na mdun tu chu gnyis nyer spyod kyang bsham/ 'brog pa lta bus gtor ma sogs zas phud dang g.yang rten mda' dar sogs sgrom du bcug cing lhag ma dngos grub tu rol pa yul lugs ltar bya/ de nas rten yod sa der sgrub pa po rnams kyang phyin te/ bsangs dud/ gser skyems/ phye mar/ 'bru sna'i mchod pa dang bcas g.yang gi srung btsugs shing*/

sgo srung bkod de rgyas gdab la bkra shis gang 'os brjod pas mthar dge bar bya/ rtag bzhugs kyi rten yod tshe slar lha mo 'khor bcas skad cig gis gsal gdab la/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol bya/ shug pa yod na dkyil ka sogs la btsugs te phyir mi 'dor/ lha klu gnyan gsum gshegs pa'i skabs su lha'i gtor ma ri rtse/ klu gtor chu mig spom ra'i gtor ma bsangs nang du 'bul dgos shing de dag dngos grub tu rol na'ang chog go /de nas chos srung gi gtor 'bul dang tshogs skong sogs mtha' rgyas su bya'o// de'i nyin mor kha brda la nye bzang po brjod cing*/ dga' ston dang 'brel ba'i chas gos kha zas bzang du bya ba dang*/ zhag gsum bdun la sogs par btang len gyi spang blang yang lugs srol dang bstun te bya/ g.yang rten gang du bzhugs pa'i mdun du ngos su snod gtsang mar zas sna 'bru sna byung ngo cog gi phud blugs shing*/ khyad par tshes grangs bzang po rnams dang*/ 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i tshe bza' btung gi phud kyis mchod cing smon lam gdab/ lo dus su sgrub pa'i kha gso ma chags par byas pas 'dod rgu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa kun// rig sngags mthu yis ster nus pa// rig pa'i nor bu rgyud rnams las// gsungs pa 'di la byi dor 'os// dge bas 'gro ba mtha' yas pa// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbul ba las// grol zhing bsod nams ye shes ni// nam mkha'i mdzod la longs spyod shog /ces pa 'di ni/ rtsa ba'i gzhung chags med rin po che'i gsung byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa nyid dar cha che yang tshad ldan byed pa dkon pas zhabs tog tu bri bar 'dun pa'i thog bstan pa'i sgron me dbon sprul rin po ches gzhan phan thugs bskyed chen pos gzhung cha lag bcas spar du bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ bka' yis bskul ma gnang ba ltar karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am/

blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes lhag bsam bzang pos dpal spungs sgrub khang chen mor spel ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ /lha mo dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyabs kyi mjug chog nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ lha mo dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyabs kyi mjug gi cho ga la gnyis/ spyi dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po ni/ mchod bstod bskul zhing nongs pa bshags/ brtan bzhugs smon lam shis pa brjod/ ces bdun las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sā ra pra mārda nā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksa buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidyā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi mant+ro ba saṃ kra ma ṇi sarba karma ā pa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes pas byin brlabs la/ hūm̐/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi sku// de bzhin gshegs dang rgyal ba'i sras// dpal gyi lha mo grogs mo brgyad// chos skyong rgyal po chen po bzhi// srid gsum g.yang bdag 'khor bcas la// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal dri bzang chab// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos su bshams dang yid las sprul// lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor ni// bde ba'i longs spyod ma tshang med// zag med dgyes skyed ci mchis pa// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir// gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hā shrī de wī sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ.arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bi dyā shabda dza pra tītstsha swā hā/ gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐ 'gro ba'i mgon po rkang gnyis gtso// dran pas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel// stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes rab pha rol phyin pa mo// nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin las// sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul// dpal gyi lha mo de la bstod// 'gro la dmigs med thugs rje yis// thabs mkhas rang bzhin skur sprul pa// 'khor gyi lha mo'i tshogs rnams la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// gsum pa ni/

hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam skul// de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas// dmigs med thugs rje chen po yis// las ngan 'dam du bying ba yi// sems can dbul bas nyen pa rnams// myur du skyob par mdzad du gsol// mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob// byang chub sems ma dpal chen mo// khyod kyi mtshan gyi rig pa mchog /'chang dang klog pa'i yon tan ni// bden par smra bas bka' stsal pa'i// bden pa'i 'bras bu mi slu bar// sgrub mchog bdag dang yon bdag la// zad mi shes pa'i 'byor pa ni// nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang sgyur mdzod// grogs mo lha mo brgyad dang bcas// sangs rgyas spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i// thugs dam gnyan po ma bsnyel bar// dpal dang skal pa bzang la sogs// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ci mchis pa// bdag dang yon bdag rnams la stsol// mthu ldan rgyal po chen po bzhis// mdo sde 'dzin la srung ba dang*// longs spyod spel bar dam bcas ltar// mdo sde'i dbang por skyabs gsol ba'i// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi// 'byor pa'i bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// mnga' thang longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i bstan skyong mthu stobs can// srid gsum g.yang gi bdag po rnams// bla ma sangs rgyas yi dam lhas// ji ltar bka' bsgos dran mdzod la// lha klu mi yi snod bcud kyi// bkra shis dge mtshan dwangs ma'i bcud// phywa g.yang dpal 'byor ci mchis pa// gnas 'dir g.yang gi rten la sdus// steng nas char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod// 'og nas mtsho bzhin skyil bar mdzod// bar nas sprin bzhin gtibs par mdzod// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub pa yi// bkra shis bde legs stsal du gsol// ces bskul zhing gsol ba btab pas srid zhi'i dwangs bcud thams cad g.yang rten rnams la 'ub kyis 'dus nas thim par bsams la rten 'brel snying po dang*/

oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra rakṣa rakṣa zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor bas brtan cing bsrung*/ bzhi pa ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces dang*/ yig brgya/ ā li kā li/ rten 'brel snying po rnams lan gsum brjod la nongs pa bshags shing lhag chad kha bskangs la nus pa brtan par bya/ lnga pa ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpal chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang sgrub pa'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar de srid du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ zhes 'bru 'thor/ sgrub pa grol nyin lha klu gnyan gsum gyi gtor ma sogs 'jog yul med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// rang rang gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// dus su 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra muḥ zhes brjod la/ ye shes pa rnams g.yang rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par mos te gnas lugs kyi ngo bo skyong*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad dgyes bzhin du rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ drug pa ni/ 'dod pa'i khams na longs spyod pa'i// dngos grub bdag gis kun thob nas// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog mchod// phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs par shog /rin chen sna bdun longs spyad nas// gter gyi dngos grub phyugs rnams dang*// gzi brjid dang ldan dpal chen mos// rtag tu bdag la srung gyur cig

/bang mdzod 'bru dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal mtshan 'khor los sgyur ba dang*// thogs med rdzu 'phrul grub nas ni// lam mchog bde la gnas par shog /ces dang*/ nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin// rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin// sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che// dgra bcom rnams ni zag pa zad// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas// bdag cag rtag tu bde legs shog /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ bdun pa ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus skyed pa'i yum// thugs rje tshad med nor gyi char pa 'bebs// margad mdog can rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// lha mo dpal chen mo yis bkra shis shog /grangs med gong nas mngon par byang chub kyang*// thugs rje'i mthu yis nor sbyin sems ma'i tshul// gser mdog rin chen rgyan ldan mdzes sdug ma// lha mo chen mo brgyad kyis bkra shis shog /gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing*// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i// gnod sbyin nor skyong rnams kyis bkra shis shog /tshangs dang brgya byin rgyal po chen po bzhi// rang rang sder bcas mthu dang dpal ldan pa// ston pa'i dam chos skyong bar mdzad pa yi// lha yi dge bsnyen rnams kyis bkra shis shog /ces pa rnams dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags dang*// nor dang longs spyod 'dod rgus phongs med par// gong nas gong du 'dzad med gter la spyod// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa la sogs pa rnams kyis mtha' rgyas par bya'o// gnyis pa khyad par gyi mjug chog ni/ sgrub pa grol nyin yon bdag la g.yang gtad bya dgos na/ gong gi brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol grub ma thag sbyin bdag bos la/ rab gnas kyi yon bdag bsgo ba sogs kyi rigs 'gre sbyar bar spro na/ sbyong ba gsum rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis bgegs bsal/

g.yang 'gugs kyi ched gong gi bskul ba tshar gcig gis byad drangs/ gang ltar yang g.yang rdzas rnams thogs te/ kye/ de ring dngos grub rgya mtsho brdol// rin chen 'byung ldan nam yang langs// bkra shis gdugs kyi snga dro la// sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag cag gis// mi yi g.yang dang phyugs kyi rtsi// pha mtshun dgra bla'i bkrag g.yang bcas// bkra shis g.yang rten bcas pa rnams// yon gyi bdag po khyod la gtad// tshe yi rten phur ma bud cig /g.yang gi mtsho mo ma skam zhig /bkra shis bde legs 'byung po shog /skyid kyi nyi ma 'char bar shog /tshe yi rten phur tshugs par shog /g.yang gi rgya mtsho 'khyil bar shog /nor gyi dpal g.yang 'phel bar shog /srid kyi chu mig rdol bar shog /bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces dang rol mo'i sgra snyan par sbyar zhing rim par gtad grub nas/ gong du smos pa'i smon lam shis brjod rgyas par bya zhing me tog 'thor/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas sbyin bdag gnas su btang la rten rnams gong du bzhugs 'os pa der bkod cing*/ mi nyams mi 'thor pa'i tshags dam par bya ste de tsam gyis skabs don 'grub pa yin la/ rten bkod srung 'dzugs rgyas par spro na gzhan du shes/ mdor bsdus pa ni/ rten yod pa'i sar sgrub pa po phyin la slar yang brtan bzhugs bskyar ma dang bcas me tog 'thor zhing sgo bcad la srung ba'i sngags brjod/ smon lam shis brjod ci rigs bya'o// zhes pa'ang 'jam pa'i dbyangs blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa'i mjug tshig dge legs char 'bebs las/ blo gros shin tu dman pa dang*/ dpe tshogs chung ba la dga' ba'i phyir don gyi snying po mdo tsam btus pa ste/ rgyas par spro na gzhung de nyid ltar shes par bya'o// //sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/
